Search settings of the GWR bandwidth selection

Source: R/gwr-bandwidth.R
ef_gwr_search.Rd

Builds the validated list of settings used by ef_gwr_bandwidth() (dev/specs/gwr-forcing.md section 4.4). The numerical settings of the fixed-bandwidth search have no default (decision GW-05 is open): a value left NULL is required only when the search needs it, and ef_gwr_bandwidth() then raises earthflux_missing_input.

Fixed bandwidth [m]. The search interval is [lower, upper]. When lower is NULL it is computed as \(\max_i d_{i,(m)}\), the largest over the stations of the distance to their m-th nearest station counting themselves (m = min_neighbours), multiplied by 1 + lower_offset for the bisquare and tricube kernels (whose weight vanishes at the bandwidth, so feasibility needs b strictly larger). When upper is NULL it is upper_factor times the largest distance between stations. The criterion is evaluated on n_grid values equally spaced in log(b), then refined with stats::optimize() (Brent) between the grid neighbours of the best feasible grid value, with absolute tolerance tol [m]. The global (OLS) model is always evaluated as the b = Inf reference.

Adaptive bandwidth (k neighbours). Exhaustive search over the whole numbers [k_min, k_max]; by default k_min is min_neighbours + 1 for the bisquare and tricube kernels and min_neighbours otherwise, and k_max is the number of stations.

Usage

ef_gwr_search(
  lower = NULL,
  upper = NULL,
  n_grid = NULL,
  tol = NULL,
  min_neighbours = NULL,
  lower_offset = NULL,
  upper_factor = NULL,
  k_min = NULL,
  k_max = NULL,
  method_adaptive = "exhaustive"
)

Arguments

lower, upper

NULL or positive numbers: bounds of the fixed bandwidth [m].

n_grid

NULL or a whole number >= 3: number of grid values of the fixed-bandwidth search.

tol

NULL or a positive number: tolerance of the refinement [m].

min_neighbours

NULL or a whole number: minimum number of neighbours at every station for a bandwidth to be feasible (see ef_gwr_fit()); NULL uses the mathematical minimum p + 1.

lower_offset

NULL or a number >= 0 (delta of the automatic lower bound for the bisquare and tricube kernels).

upper_factor

NULL or a positive number (factor of the largest inter-station distance for the automatic upper bound).

k_min, k_max

NULL or whole numbers >= 1: bounds of the adaptive search (neighbours).

method_adaptive

Character. Search over k: only "exhaustive" is implemented.

Value

A list of class earthflux_gwr_search with the settings.

Details

These values are search conventions, not scientific constants; they are recorded in the selection object. Invalid values raise earthflux_domain_error or earthflux_input_error.

See also

Other spatial regionalization functions: ef_gwr_bandwidth(), ef_gwr_diagnostics(), ef_gwr_fit(), ef_gwr_predict()

Examples

ef_gwr_search(n_grid = 30, tol = 1, lower_offset = 0.01, upper_factor = 2)
#> $lower
#> NULL
#> 
#> $upper
#> NULL
#> 
#> $n_grid
#> [1] 30
#> 
#> $tol
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $min_neighbours
#> NULL
#> 
#> $lower_offset
#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $upper_factor
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $k_min
#> NULL
#> 
#> $k_max
#> NULL
#> 
#> $method_adaptive
#> [1] "exhaustive"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_gwr_search" "list"
